assets.acceptance: Seethargundu name and light-roast descriptor readable; no label crop.

assets.name: Easy Pour brewing demonstration, hands
assets.acceptance: Tear, open and anchor actions are physically correct and match the brand instructions.

assets.name: Hot water pour and bloom footage
assets.acceptance: Water visibly contacts the coffee bed; bloom and drip read in macro; no spill or continuity break.

assets.name: Warm kitchen background
assets.acceptance: Full-canvas background holds a consistent grade across all six shots.

assets.name: Finished cup of coffee
assets.acceptance: Finished cup matches the brewed colour; rim clean; steam visible without obscuring the pack.

assets.name: Voice over, warm Indian English
assets.acceptance: Performer release present; intelligible read; no claim beyond the canonical script.

assets.name: Music bed, 20 seconds
assets.acceptance: Licence covers paid YouTube; 20-second edit supports the 275 range lift and 445 resolve.

assets.name: Water pour sound effect
assets.acceptance: Pour sound syncs to the water action without a phasing artefact.

assets.name: Brand sting
assets.acceptance: Sting lands under the end card and does not mask the VO.

assets.name: Captured Mixed Bag fallback
assets.acceptance: Physical pack label is square to camera and at least as legible as the supplied image.

assets.name: Music fallback track
assets.acceptance: Fallback bed matches the primary tempo and emotional resolve.

assets.name: Synthetic narration fallback
assets.acceptance: Synthetic read matches the canonical script and carries the disclosure decision.
